definitions.explanation: Done or known only halfway, without real commitment or depth. Often in the negative: something that a half-hearted effort cannot achieve.

examples.japanese: {生半可|なまはんか}な⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧。
{生半可|なまはんか}な⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{続|つづ}かない→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: You won't keep it up if you're only half-serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生半可|なまはんか}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: An older student told me that becoming a doctor takes more than a half-hearted effort.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生半可|なまはんか}な⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: a smattering of knowledge
- {生半可|なまはんか}な⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧ / ⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧: a half-hearted attitude / resolve
- {生半可|なまはんか}なこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it is no easy matter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中途半端|ちゅうとはんぱ}→中途半端：11305_chuutohanpa⟧: half-finished, neither one thing nor the other. {生半可|なまはんか} is about shallow knowledge or commitment, and sounds sharper.
- ⟦いい{加減|かげん}→いい加減：09353_iikagen⟧: careless, sloppy
